get.description:
Liveness probe endpoint.

Always returns 200 if the process is alive. This endpoint should be used
for Kubernetes liveness probes to detect if the application is responsive.

Also says which build is live — ``version`` (the app version passed to create_api,
the same one Sentry gets) and ``started_at`` — so a rollout is one request to check.

Readiness probe endpoint for load balancers and Kubernetes.

Returns 200 during normal operation and 503 during shutdown.
During shutdown, this signals to load balancers and K8s to stop
sending new traffic to this instance.

Simple ping endpoint to verify API is responding.
Returns immediately with pong response.

post.description:
Webhook endpoint for YooKassa payment confirmations.

Returns:
    - 200 OK: Webhook processed successfully
    - 400 Bad Request: Invalid JSON, missing fields, permanent business errors
    - 500 Internal Error: Transient business errors, unknown errors
    - 503 Service Unavailable: Infrastructure errors (DB, Redis)

Webhook endpoint for Telegram Stars payment confirmations from web interface.

DORMANT (kept intentionally): the live Telegram Stars path is the aiogram bot — pre-checkout
and successful_payment arrive as bot updates and are handled in
``core/infrastructure/telegram/handlers/payments.py`` (the bot long-polls). Nothing currently
POSTs to this HTTP endpoint. It is retained — not deleted — because it is a thin, correct-by-
construction adapter: it routes the same payload contract through the unified
``services.payments.process_callback(..., TELEGRAM_STARS)`` as the bot handler, so a future
web/non-Telegram Stars flow can light it up without re-implementing payment finalization. If
that future never materializes, this and its router registration can be removed wholesale.

Returns:
    - 200 OK: Webhook processed successfully
    - 400 Bad Request: Invalid JSON, missing fields, permanent business errors
    - 500 Internal Error: Transient business errors, unknown errors
    - 503 Service Unavailable: Infrastructure errors (DB, Redis)

SeenFeaturesPatch.title: SeenFeaturesPatch
SeenFeaturesPatch.description:
Body for PATCH /users/me/seen-features.

A shallow `feature_key -> value` map, merged into `users.seen_features` via
JSONB `||` (top-level keys only). Hardened because it is user-writable:
keys must be dotted lowercase identifiers, the map is bounded, and values
are at most one level deep.
